## Houston 1.0.7

### What's new

- **Routines pause when your AI plan hits its usage limit.** Instead of failing every few minutes, a routine waits until your plan resets and shows "Paused until" with the time. To keep it running now, pick another model.
- **Edits on your board show up instantly.** Creating, moving, renaming and deleting cards no longer wait for the server, and a change that can't be saved is undone with a short note.
- **Starting an AI Employee's first day without an AI connected** now shows a "Connect AI" button instead of an error.
- **Routine triggers that can't fire tell you why**, and what to do: pick a different event, or check the routine's settings.
- **Only the person a question or approval is for can answer it** in a shared chat.

### Fixes and polish

- App updates continue where they left off after a dropped connection, instead of starting over.
- A message that can't start because the AI Employee holds too much saved now says so, instead of spinning forever.
- A chat no longer gets stuck when a reply was cut short; you're told it couldn't be confirmed.
- An upload cut off mid-way now says so, instead of "connection lost".
- If your GitHub Copilot billing is locked, Houston tells you, and offers to pick another AI.
- Bug reports are delivered even when our issue tracker is full.
- Saving a file to a folder that no longer exists asks you to pick another folder.
- Waking your computer no longer briefly shows sign-in errors.
- The move-to-cloud screen no longer comes back after you sign out and in again.
- Additional reliability improvements under the hood.

### Before you upgrade

- Quit Houston before installing. macOS doesn't always replace a running app. If in doubt, delete Houston from Applications and drag the new copy in.
